images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single isolated FULL BODY REAR VIEW character cut-out, using the attached character sheet as identity and engraving-style reference. This is the same young Victorian storybook girl from the sheet's top-row back view. She is standing STILL, calmly watching something ahead, both feet planted close together, arms resting naturally near her sides, narrow balanced silhouette. Camera at ordinary standing eye level behind her, straight rear view with only a very slight natural shoulder angle; no running stride, no falling, no overhead viewpoint. Her long softly curled chestnut-brown hair lies down her back with a small subdued blue-grey period ribbon. Ochre-yellow puff-sleeved calf-length dress, ivory pinafore tied in a clear neat bow behind waist, plain stockings, dark brown strap shoes. Back costume construction and body proportions must match reference. Show head to both shoes completely with modest transparent margins. Portrait composition intended for logical 120x220 placement; keep arms/hair/skirt reasonably narrow so she does not hide nearby scene characters. Not a fashion portrait or dramatic pose. Late nineteenth-century British book engraving, delicate brown-black ink contours #2A211A, restrained parallel hatching, gentle warm paper highlights within the figure, subtle muted antique hand-colour. Dress #D8B348, chestnut hair #68472D with #8A6543 highlights, ivory #F4EFE5. Same line density and fine print character as reference; no thick vector outline, glossy painting, anime, chibi, 3D, oversaturated colour. Genuinely transparent background, no scene, no floor, no cast shadow, no captions, labels, lettering or frame. Exactly one complete illustration, not a sheet, no separate parts.
